title.en: Special Purpose Books and the Cash Book
title.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಉದ್ದೇಶದ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ

heading.en: Too many entries for one journal
heading.kn: ಒಂದೇ ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕಕ್ಕೆ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನಮೂದುಗಳು

hook.en: A busy supermarket has thousands of cash sales a day. Writing each in one journal would be slow, so business uses separate books for each type of transaction.
hook.kn: ಜನನಿಬಿಡ ಸೂಪರ್ ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ನಗದು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುವುದು ನಿಧಾನ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಗೆಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇರೆ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: A busy supermarket has thousands of cash sales a day. Writing each in one journal would be slow, so business uses separate books for each type of transaction.

body.en: The journal is divided into special purpose books: the cash book (cash receipts and payments), the purchases book (credit purchases of goods), the purchases return book, the sales book (credit sales of goods), the sales return book, and the journal proper for everything else. They save time, allow division of work and give quick information about each type of transaction.
body.kn: ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಖರೀದಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಖರೀದಿ ವಾಪಸಾತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಮಾರಾಟ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಮಾರಾಟ ವಾಪಸಾತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮತ್ತು ಜರ್ನಲ್ ಪ್ರಾಪರ್ ಎಂದು ವಿಭಜಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

Journal proper: entries that fit no other book

title.en: On the board: Special books and the cash book

say.en: The journal is split into special books, one for each common kind of transaction.
The cash book: receipts on the debit side.
Receipts 35,000, payments 15,500. The balance c/d is 19,500, so both sides total 35,000.
Cash paid can never exceed cash available: the cash book always has a debit balance or nil.

prompt.en: Sort each transaction into the special purpose book where it is first recorded.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವನ್ನು ಅದು ಮೊದಲು ದಾಖಲಾಗುವ ವಿಶೇಷ ಪುಸ್ತಕಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Bought goods on credit from Sohan
Bought goods on credit from Gita Traders
Received cash from Ravi, a debtor
Sent a debit note to Gita Traders for goods returned

explanation.en: All cash transactions go to the cash book. Only credit purchases of goods for resale go to the purchases book, and their returns to the purchases return book. Credit purchases of assets and adjustments such as depreciation go to the journal proper.

body.en: The cash book has a debit side for receipts and a credit side for payments, each with Date, Particulars, Receipt or Voucher number, L.F. and Amount. It is both a book of original entry and the cash account of the ledger. It is balanced like an account; since cash paid can never exceed cash available, it always shows a debit balance or nil.
body.kn: ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ, ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿ. ಇದು ಮೂಲ ನಮೂದು ಪುಸ್ತಕವೂ ಹೌದು, ನಗದು ಖಾತೆಯೂ ಹೌದು. ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Prepare the simple cash book of Naveen Stores for May 2025: May 1 cash in hand ₹12,000; May 4 received from Ramesh ₹8,000; May 9 cash sales ₹15,000; May 14 paid wages ₹3,000; May 20 bought goods for cash ₹10,000; May 31 paid rent ₹2,500.

steps.en: Debit side: To Balance b/d 12,000; To Ramesh 8,000; To Sales A/c 15,000; total 35,000.
Credit side: By Wages A/c 3,000; By Purchases A/c 10,000; By Rent A/c 2,500; total 15,500.
Balance = 35,000 − 15,500 = 19,500, entered as May 31 By Balance c/d 19,500.
Both sides total ₹35,000; June 1 To Balance b/d 19,500.

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. Prepare the simple cash book of Naveen Stores for May 2025: May 1 cash in hand ₹12,000; May 4 received from Ramesh ₹8,000; May 9 cash sales ₹15,000; May 14 paid wages ₹3,000; May 20 bought goods for cash ₹10,000; May 31 paid rent ₹2,500.

points.en: Special purpose books divide the journal by type of transaction.

points.en: The cash book is both a journal and the cash account.

points.en: Receipts on the debit side, payments on the credit side.
points.kn: ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಬದಿಗೆ, ಪಾವತಿ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬದಿಗೆ.

homework.en: Prepare a simple cash book from five transactions of your own and balance it.

narration.en: Recap. Special purpose books divide the journal by type of transaction. The cash book is both a journal and the cash account. Receipts on the debit side, payments on the credit side. The cash balance is always debit or nil.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವಿಶೇಷ ಉದ್ದೇಶದ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಬಗೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ವಿಭಜಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕವೂ ನಗದು ಖಾತೆಯೂ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಬದಿಗೆ, ಪಾವತಿ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬದಿಗೆ. ನಗದು ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಶೂನ್ಯ.
